Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

CellSize.description: The size of a cell in the entity's local units: cell (x, y) spans [x CellSize.x, (x + 1) CellSize.x] in X.

ChunkSize.description: The cells a chunk holds a side: a power of two from 1 to 64 (16 by default).

Palette.description: At most 65535 entries; a cell value k draws Palette[k - 1].

Chunks.description: The stored chunks, sorted by Y, then X, each once, none empty; at most 4194304 cells in all.

TilemapTile.description: One entry of a tilemap's palette: the sprite sheet frame drawn in the cells holding it, and whether the TilemapCollider collides with them.

Sheet.description: The sprite sheet the tile is cut from; null draws nothing.

Frame.description: The index of the frame in the sheet's Frames, from 0; a frame the sheet lacks draws nothing (TILEMAP_FRAME_OUT_OF_RANGE).

Solid.description: Whether the TilemapCollider collides with the cells holding this entry.

TilemapChunk.description: A square of ChunkSize x ChunkSize cells of a tilemap, stored while one of them is not empty; chunk (X, Y) holds the cells from (X ChunkSize, Y ChunkSize).

X.description: The chunk's column: its cells' x lie in [X ChunkSize, (X + 1) ChunkSize), and in [-1048576, 1048576).

Y.description: The chunk's row: its cells' y lie in [Y ChunkSize, (Y + 1) ChunkSize), and in [-1048576, 1048576).

Tiles.description: The ChunkSize^2 cell values, row by row from the chunk's bottom row up, each row left to right: 0 for an empty cell, k for Palette[k - 1]; not all 0.
